# Don't Spiral

> Your 24/7 safe space when relationship anxiety hits. AI-powered support for ROCD, jealousy, overthinking, and breakup anxiety. Not therapy — a friend who gets it.

## About

Don't Spiral is a mobile app (iOS and Android) that acts as an AI relationship-anxiety
coach. It remembers your story and helps you find clarity before you react — available
around the clock for ROCD, jealousy, overthinking, and breakup anxiety. It is not
therapy and not a replacement for professional help.
